name: constant-time-testing
description: Measures timing side channels in cryptographic implementations by running them, using dudect for statistical analysis and Timecop over Valgrind for dynamic tracing. Covers the formal, symbolic, dynamic, and statistical tool categories and how to read a result. Use when testing whether a running implementation is constant-time, measuring timing variance on a compiled binary, or investigating a suspected timing attack. Not for statically inspecting compiler output — the constant-time-analysis plug
author: trailofbits
summary_zh: 用于检测密码学实现是否存在时序侧信道，适合评估编译后二进制的恒定时间特性或排查疑似时序攻击。
